name: What Comes Next

angles.text: As a shaman, you travel to Mulgore to meet the Earthen Ring, a revered shamanic organization devoted to soothing Azeroth's elemental spirits.
As a tauren, you travel to Mulgore, your people's ancestral homeland. The Earthen Ring keeps its operations there.

faq.answer: The expedition is preparing to leave Zephras Isle after earning High Elder Shadowsong's blessing and defeating the local cult. Travelers are ready to cross the skies by skycutter to Kalimdor.
faq.q: What is the quest What Comes Next?

faq.answer: Skycutters connect Zephras Isle with Mulgore, a grassy mesa region in central Kalimdor. The Earthen Ring makes its home there, and advance members of the expedition are already waiting.
Ayessa Dawnsinger coordinates the departure from Zephras Isle. Preparations are in place, test flights have succeeded, and High Elder Shadowsong has blessed the expedition's departure.
Muln worked to establish steady skycutter travel between Zephras Isle and Mulgore. He conducted test voyages to ensure safe passage across the skies.
The Earthen Ring is an organization of shamans devoted to keeping harmony among the elemental spirits. Its members are the expedition's contacts and hosts in Mulgore.
The local cult is defeated, and High Elder Shadowsong has blessed the expedition. With those tasks complete, the expedition can leave Zephras Isle and continue to the mainland.
faq.q: Why is the expedition leaving Zephras Isle?

sections.body: High Elder Shadowsong has blessed the expedition's onward journey from Zephras Isle, where the local cult has been defeated and safety restored. The expedition now looks beyond the island, with its focus set on travel across the open skies toward Kalimdor. Ayessa Dawnsinger coordinates the final departure for those ready to leave.
sections.title: Departure from Zephras Isle

sections.body: Muln worked to secure steady skycutter travel between Zephras Isle and Mulgore. Test voyages succeeded, and an advance party has already crossed over. They wait on the other side to make contact with the shaman of the Earthen Ring.
sections.title: Skycutters to Mulgore

summary: On Zephras Isle, the expedition prepares to cross the skies for Kalimdor. The local cult is defeated, and High Elder Shadowsong has given his blessing. Skycutters now carry travelers between the island and Mulgore.
